# 01 — EDA

This notebook ingests the per-week chart snapshots and the song-level
metadata, and produces the first descriptive plots:

- How many *unique* songs per year? (heavy reuse vs turnover)
- Top 20 most persistent songs across 2020–2025.
- Distribution of weekly ranks per year (rank entropy proxy).
- Cross-platform / cross-year overlap of artists.

```{r paths}
ROOT     <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input()), "..", ".."), mustWork = FALSE)
RAW_DIR  <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "raw", "weekly_top100")
EMB_DIR  <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "embeddings")
META_FN  <- file.path(EMB_DIR, "song_metadata.csv")
```
